fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Order.Reverse
fields.Description: Reverse money a booked order holds: cancel a subscription (Orders.CancelSubscription, with its credit memo), refund a payment (Orders.RefundPayment), move an account credit to another order (Orders.ApplyAccountCredit), or lower an agreed amount (Orders.AmendArrangement with NewAmount). Each refuses a caller without it, before any read or write; a record of something the payment gateway already did is exempt. Held by the Finance role (bc-aidp-next-golive#454). Without this row, all four are refused.
